known_deviations.reason: Real trend after the training years: FG share of midfield 4th-down kicks rose from 8-10% (2016-19) to 20% (2023), 25% (2024), 28% (2025). The caller reflects coaching through 2023.
Same trend as fourthDown.MID.fieldGoal: more midfield field goals, fewer punts, after 2023.
Man share swings season to season (29% 2022, 41% 2023, 49% 2024, 32% 2025), partly confounded by the 2023 change in charting source (NGS to FTN). Not a model bug.
Real shift toward Nickel Cover 2 in 2024-2025 (charted Cover 2 rows about 2,500 a season through 2022, 4,527 in 2024, 5,004 in 2025).
Mirror of preset.nickelCover2: the 2024-2025 shift from Cover 4 to Cover 2.
